---
title: "4.1: Visualization Implementation"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

# DATA 202 hack for displaying plotly within RStudio:
if 'r' in globals() and r['.Platform$GUI'] == "RStudio" and r['suppressMessages(requireNamespace("htmltools"))']:
  r[".GlobalEnv$to_html <- function(x) { print(htmltools::HTML(x)) }"] and None
  def show_plot(p): r.to_html(p._repr_html_())
else:
  def show_plot(p): return p
# End hack
```


## Q&A

- Bar vs histogram

## bar plots

```{python}
loans_full_schema = pd.read_excel('../../static/data/openintro_loans_full_schema.xlsx')
```

https://plotly.com/python/reference/layout/xaxis/#layout-xaxis-categoryorder

```{python}
loans = loans_full_schema[['loan_amount', 'interest_rate', 'term', 'grade', 'state', 'annual_income', 'homeownership', 'debt_to_income']]
```


```{python}
show_plot(
  px.histogram(loans, x="state")
  .update_xaxes(categoryorder="total descending"))
```


```{python}
show_plot(
  px.histogram(loans_full_schema, y="loan_purpose")
  .update_yaxes(categoryorder="total ascending"))
```
